This page navigates the repository's governance corpus, which lives on this
site as the articles listed below (converted from the former `docs/` tree).
It links, never copies: the roster is re-derived from the repository bytes
by the governing test, so an article added or renamed without a bridge row
reddens the suite.

The paper corpus -- the manuscript spine, the campaign devlogs, the research
dossiers and the independent-review round -- is not part of this site. It
lives in the top-level `paper/` tree of the repository, self-contained and
outside the package build; start from `paper/README.md` there.

For the user-facing learning path (install, first analysis, and the task
guides), start at [Get started](get-started.html) and the [tour](tour.html).
